en: Now, let's start with prompt and context
engineering, which is a general thing, not
limited to Codex. But it is important
because using good prompts will yield good
results, no matter where you're using large
language models or where you're working with
large language models. And a prompt, the
thing you send to Codex, is really just a
combination of your specific instructions
telling the model what it should do and the
then any relevant context that helps the
model and the AI achieve your goal or
complete the tasks you gave it. And the
relevant part here really matters. It's far
too easy to give the model too much context
and that will lead to worse results. So
proper context engineering really is the art
of identifying the relevant context and
passing just that relevant context to the
model. And you'll see examples for that
throughout the course and you'll learn how
to in general send good prompts to Codex.
